versions.source: Claude API list prices, USD per million tokens. First table: it applies to every earlier request too, because no earlier list was recorded. Add a new version, never edit this one, when a price changes.

claude-opus-4-8.source: Claude API pricing page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing): $5 input, $6.25 5m write, $10 1h write, $0.50 cache hit, $25 output per MTok; the writes are the version's 1.25x and 2x.

gpt-6.1-sol.source: OpenAI API standard tier as OpenAI's model and pricing pages state it (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol, /api/docs/pricing), read through a search restricted to OpenAI's domains: $2 input, $0.10 cached input, $2.50 cache write (1.25x, the version's 5m multiplier; Codex rows put cache writes in cache_write_5m), $10 output per MTok; above 272K input tokens the whole request is 2x input and cache and 1.5x output. Batch, Flex, fast and ultrafast tiers are not modelled.

opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free.source: OpenCode free tier; OpenCode itself records cost 0 for these rows.

opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.source: OpenCode Go list price at Off-Peak, USD per MTok, from OpenCode's own model catalog models.dev (github.com/sst/models.dev, providers/opencode-go/models/deepseek-v4.1-flash.toml at commit 065c9d1), which transcribes opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go/ (accessed 2026-10-21); opencode.ai itself could not be opened from the session. Peak (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday) is 2x and is not modelled. Go lists no cache-write price; a cache write is priced at the version's 1.25x input. On the Go subscription this is not the bill; it compares work.

versions.source: Copies every model of version 2026-11-09 and corrects claude-sonnet-5-5's cache_read (0.20 to 0.10, an error, not a price change) and adds claude-fable-5-2. It has the same effective_from as 2026-11-09, so it is the version in effect for every moment 2026-11-09 was (a tie goes to the later version in this file).

claude-fable-5-2.source: Claude API pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-11-10): Claude Fable 5.2 $8 input, $10 5m write, $16 1h write, $0.20 cache hit, $40 output per MTok; the writes are the version's 1.25x and 2x.

claude-sonnet-5-5.source: Correction of an error, not a price change: versions 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-09 list cache_read 0.20, but the Claude API pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-11-10) lists Sonnet 5.5 cache hits at $0.10 per MTok, its footnote 0.05x base input; input $2 and output $10 were right and are unchanged.
